description:
## Why

`budget.*` frontmatter is parsed by `fz-fixture-metadata` into `BudgetAssertion`s, but nothing reads them: the dump-budget trial it fed was removed with the old compiler front door. 50 fixtures under `fixtures2/behavior/` each declare 10 budget lines that look like pins and pin nothing. Owner decision 2026-09-25: toss them. Compiler-shape claims belong to contract metrics (`assert.metric.*`).

## What changes

- `fixture-metadata`: delete `BudgetAssertion`, `FixtureMatrixMetadata::budget_assertions`, the `budget.` parse arm and its `participates_in_matrix` clause. A `budget.*` key becomes an unknown-key error, so none can come back silently.
- Delete the 500 `# budget.*` lines from the 50 fixtures.
- Docs: drop budgets from `.agent/docs/fixtures.md`, `fixtures2/GOLDEN.md` (the budget medium and the Fixture Dump Budgets section) and README.

## Signal

`grep -rn 'budget\.' fixtures2 fixture-metadata tests .agent/docs` finds nothing; full gate green.
title: Toss the unchecked budget.* fixture frontmatter
